name: Map Multi Session Decisions
summary: Map a large uncertain effort as bounded decisions, dependencies, frontier work, and explicit fog.
description: Map an effort too uncertain for one session into a destination, resolved decisions, bounded decision nodes, dependency frontier, unknown territory, and handoff rules. Use before execution when premature task breakdown would encode guesses.
risk_reason: This skill maps a large uncertain effort as bounded decisions, dependencies, frontier work, and explicit fog; it does not pre-slice unknown territory into invented tasks merely to make the map look complete.
refuses: It does not pre-slice unknown territory into invented tasks merely to make the map look complete.
It does not let concurrent sessions claim the same decision or duplicate its authoritative answer.
It does not treat a planning map as authority to execute external, destructive, or privileged actions.

operational.latency_reason: The skill maps a large uncertain effort as bounded decisions, dependencies, frontier work, and explicit fog, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
